research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, learn how all 109 writable facilities change future system-wide cumulative TFV, evaluate all 109 facilities for immediate and delayed control value, optimize a predicted-beneficial multi-facility action sequence inside empirical TrainFit support, execute the first 10-minute target, then re-observe

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensing -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete reference/candidate H360 actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.step3: HOLD is exact zero; screen all 109 facilities with pulse and persistent probes, optimize predicted-beneficial facilities inside TrainFit joint-density support, execute if optimized predicted delta TFV < 0, otherwise HOLD
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline label generator and authoritative control evaluation truth; never the online candidate evaluator

time_contract.terminal_tail: hold the final H120 target through H360

action_contract.engineering_bounds: per-facility physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.support_bounds: per-facility TrainFit q95 action magnitudes plus TrainFit joint changed-facility density; q95 is used only when the checkpoint carries the V2 density extension, otherwise q90 is retained

step2_current.primary_target: authoritative exact SWMM delta TFV relative to same-prefix reference
step2_current.model: shared pairwise V(candidate)-V(reference), decomposed into 109 facility value differences plus multi-facility interaction value difference
step2_current.main_stage: exact single-facility branches train 109 facility main-value differences with facility-balanced regression
step2_current.joint_stage: multi-facility branches are balanced by changed-facility count and train the shared facility representation plus interaction head, so rare dense coordination cannot be drowned out by sparse joint branches
step2_current.control_stage: D3 HOLD-reference TrainFit groups only; late value representation receives symmetric sign calibration for the actual online act-vs-HOLD decision
step2_current.top1_policy: exact cached-candidate top1 is diagnostic only
step2_current.d4_role: reference-shift stress diagnostic; poor D4 selection does not block HOLD-reference Step3
step2_current.action_support_artifact: checkpoint.action_support stores per-facility q95 radii and q50/q75/q90/q95/q99/max joint changed-facility counts

step3_current.screening: all 109 facilities; up/down half/full radius; pulse and persistent probes
step3_current.beneficial_definition: facility best pulse/persistent probe predicted delta TFV < 0
step3_current.active_set: rank all predicted-beneficial facilities; default ceiling is TrainFit joint q95 when V2 density support exists, otherwise fail closed to q90; never exceed observed TrainFit joint maximum
step3_current.optimization: bounded L-BFGS-B across 12 free 10-minute blocks for the dynamic active set
step3_current.admission: no separate calibrated threshold; execute when optimized predicted delta TFV < 0, otherwise HOLD
step3_current.execute: first 10-minute target only; re-observe before the next decision

data_boundaries.D2: primary single-facility attribution and long-duration numeric supervision
data_boundaries.D3: HOLD-reference temporal/joint supervision and online control-reference supervision
data_boundaries.D4_FIT: Sparse-RBC-reference local first-move training/stress data; not the runtime reference

legacy.V4_training: runtime-compatible legacy checkpoint only; new training uses V5

promotion_rule: prove 109/109 facility learning, dense-joint held-out control value and support-aware Step3 behavior, then validate exact first moves with authoritative Development SWMM before any Validation/Final promotion
